description: List the API's operations (method, path, summary) from the OpenAPI contract, optionally filtered by a substring of the path or summary.

format.description: 'list' for method/path/summary lines (default), or 'openapi' for the raw OpenAPI definition.

path.description: With format=openapi, return just this path, e.g. /v1/documents/send.

name: docs_list_endpoints
